## Quarto


```{r}
#Testing Plot combinations for plot_crew_survey
varName.options <- c(
  'port',
  'fishery',
  'demographic',
  'personal_life',
  'history',
  'employment_history',
  'employment_conditions',
  'compensation',
  'expenses',
  'satisfaction',
  'perceptions'
)
report.options <- c('MidAtlantic', 'NewEngland')
plottype.options <- c('ts', 'bar')

plot.combs <- expand.grid(
  varName = varName.options,
  report = report.options,
  plottype = plottype.options
)

devtools::load_all()
```

```{r, results = "asis"}
for (i in 1:nrow(plot.combs)) {
  # plot.title <- paste(
  #   plot.combs$report[i],
  #   plot.combs$varName[i],
  #   plot.combs$plottype[i],
  #   sep = ': '
  # )

  p <- plot_crew_survey(
    report = plot.combs$report[i],
    varName = plot.combs$varName[i],
    plottype = plot.combs$plottype[i],
    n = 0
  )
title <- paste("Plot", i)
combo <- plot.combs[i,]

res <- knitr::knit_child(text = paste(
  paste("##", title),
  "This plot is showing the following parameter inputs:",
  "`r knitr::kable(combo)`",
  "Plots:",
  "```{r, echo = FALSE}",
  "print(p)",
  "```",
  "end of plot", i,
  "\n\n",
  sep = "\n\n"
),
quiet = TRUE)
cat(res, sep = "\n\n")
  # print(p)
}
```
